				every_state = { limit = { is_on_continent = europe NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } OR = { is_core_of = ROOT any_country = { is_subject_of = ROOT PREV = { is_core_of = PREV } } } } add_claim_by = ROOT }
			}
			if = { limit = { country_exists = BUL } BUL = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ITA modifier = wif_ita_friendship_opinion } } }
		}
	}

	}
